comment: How the page presents each release of the firmware: the name it goes by here, and a line about where it stands. A release that is not listed is shown by its own state on GitHub (verified, untested or draft). `pending` names what the page will list once its files are in a release.

release-2026-11-15.label: Alpha (portrait screen)
release-2026-11-15.note: Validated on a unit through the night of 14 to 15 Nov 2026. The way back if the Beta gives trouble.

release-2026-11-16-beta.label: Beta (Anubis, landscape screen)
release-2026-11-16-beta.note: The newest master, with the landscape screen. It is the most up to date, and it may contain bugs. For the sensors, use the Alpha.
